_about: The one setup file of this project: who the brand is, each stream it speaks as, how sends are driven, which jobs run and which plugin plays which role. `engine init` and the dashboard's Setup page write it, so nobody has to open it. the engine's engine.json (plugins/comms-engine/ in the template) holds the shipped defaults; this file is merged over it, engine.local.json (per machine, gitignored) over this, the environment over all. `engine validate` checks it and `engine apply` renders the tables of .atelier/memory/streams.md from it. Never a secret, never a person's name. brand.example.json is a filled-in one.
_engine_about: The comms-engine plugin version this brand runs. `engine doctor` fails when the loaded plugin is another; move it after reading the release, as a tracked change.
_streams_about: One entry per stream, the brand's own first, keyed by slug. `owner` is confirmed or unset, never a name. `autopilot` is nothing (drafts only), `by switch` (each kind of send follows its review mode), or the rule a decision file set. `review` is the default mode per kind of send: review (a person decides) or auto (what passes the checks goes out); a person changes one on the dashboard, as a recorded act. A stream stays shut until its owner is confirmed, its voice is written and its quiet hours are set.

acme.name: Acme
acme.objectives: intent engagement (saves, quote posts, substantive replies, reposts, link clicks); reach: not opted in; north star: set at onboarding
acme.blocked_topics: everything, until this stream's `instincts.md` never-say lines and its `handles.private.md` denylist are written

_drivers_about: How sends and X reads are carried, for every stream here (a stream may carry its own `drivers`). write: native or composio. x_read (listening) and x_own (our own posts and mentions): twitterapi or composio; composio reads also wait for their price sign-off.
_jobs_about: Which scheduled jobs are on. A job set false is left out of the all-jobs install; `engine enable <job>` still loads one by name.
_plugins_about: Which plugin agent or skill plays which role, with its pinned version and the brief that carries this repository's rules. Empty keeps the defaults of engine.json.
